svg.title: Tidewharf Landing — Twin ferry berths and a rigged customs wharf
svg.desc: A customs hut, two ferries and their mast gantries create a welcoming dock maze. Cargo stacks connect the boardwalk to the sail loft; danger berths are clearly separated.
